name: Zoho CRM
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Zoho CRM, manage a focused contact and deal pipeline without recreating the wider Zoho suite. The hard boundary is ecosystem breadth, integrations, automation, analytics, and enterprise controls, plus integrations, data quality, and workflow lock-in.
